Name: Christmas Crops
Author: s24sammy
Description:
[size=3]Ever wish you could grow Candy Canes on your farm? Now you can![/size]

This mod add some Christmas-themed crops and craftables to the game. Currently this mod includes Candy Canes, Peppermint Candies, and Gingerbread (plus a Gingerbread Man!). This mod is still in early-development, but in the future you will be able to grow tons of Christmas Crops!

Manifest.Name: Christmas Crops
Manifest.Description: Adds various festive crops and craftables for Christmas.
